# Wholehearted Animal Removal

Wholehearted Animal Removal provides deceased animal removal and transport for households, farms, and large-animal owners across the South Sound region of Washington, including horses, livestock, pets, and wildlife.

## Services
- Deceased horse and livestock removal
- Deceased pet removal (dogs, cats, small animals)
- Deceased wildlife removal
- Coordination with veterinarians for same-day euthanasia removal

## Service area
- Pierce County
- King County
- Thurston County
- Lewis County
- Shelton, Elma, and Castle Rock, WA

## Contact
- Website: https://wholeheartedanimalremoval.com/
- Phone: (253) 905-2220

## Business
Wholehearted Animal Removal is a second-generation, family-owned business run by Aaron, providing prompt, discreet, and respectful deceased animal removal for families and farm owners during a difficult time.
